upstreamFrontmatter.name: agent-browser
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Browser automation CLI (Chrome via CDP). Use for navigating sites, filling forms, clicking, screenshots, scraping, web-app testing, login flows. Triggers (EN): "open a website", "fill out a form", "click", "take a screenshot", "scrape a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser". Триггеры (RU): "открой сайт", "зайди на", "заполни форму", "кликни", "нажми кнопку", "скриншот страницы", "залогинься на сайте", "спарси", "парсинг", "скрапинг", "протестируй UI", "проверь как выглядит". Skip when: the same task is doable via a dedicated CLI (jira/confluence/glab/time) — prefer those. Only fall back to browser when UI interaction is unavoidable.

adaptations: Registered as an explicit user-approved exception to the local-only base profile.
